items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Sheffield was known for breaking down doors to bootlegging joints

ctx.x: Recorded were the songs, 'My Mamie's Blues,' and 'Sheffield's Blues.' "Sheffield's Blues" became somewhat of a hit for the group as it was written for a legendary detective in the area, one of the few black detectives at this time.
Mr. Sheffield was known for breaking down doors to bootlegging joints
and even a private residence if he thought that booze was being sold.
